doc.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Why the Marines did not commission musicians
summary: Brown asks why he never went to officer school; the Marines did not commission music majors.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Here you are. You have a college degree. Did you graduate from Dillard? Is that correct?
I don’t understand why you weren’t able to go to OCS or some sort of officer training, rather than being . . .

Oh yeah, everybody. You got to go past the shrink when you get in the military. He said, “Why didn’t you apply for OC?” I say, “The Marine Corps don’t commission music majors,” for whatever reason, not that I was looking to be a Marine officer anyway.
